tour.title: Welcome & Architectural Vision
tour.description: Start your journey with the high-level entry points that establish the project as a secure VPS monitoring framework. Read the foundational architecture records documenting execution models, security policies, and hardening rules.

tour.title: Configuration Engine & Shared Security Defaults
tour.description: Explore the heart of the application's configuration layer, which controls runtime modes (CI vs. production), handles database connections, parses mail configs, and manages decryption or loading of system secrets.
tour.languageLesson: The codebase leverages lazy importing and decoupling of configuration checks to prevent runtime failures during the import stage in environments lacking certain local credentials.

tour.title: Batch Log Ingestion and Threat Analysis
tour.description: Understand how security event logs (Fail2ban, kernel blocks, honeypot triggers) are systematically parsed, mapped to geo-location, stored in the database, and checked against potential threat levels.

tour.title: Docker Resource Telemetry
tour.description: Learn how host resources and container health statistics are retrieved from the Docker API. The metric values are processed into structured reports and formatted into HTML alerts.

tour.title: Containerized Infrastructure and Scheduling
tour.description: Inspect the multi-stack orchestration layer. You'll see compose manifests and custom configurations for PostgreSQL database operations, postfix relays, and localized cron jobs driving the automated monitoring process.

tour.title: Automated Security Policy Audits
tour.description: Examine the custom Python and shell script suite that automatically audits the workspace runtime. It analyzes configuration patterns, reports privilege escalation risks, and validates Dockerfile security boundaries.

tour.title: Validating the Architecture
tour.description: Conclude by exploring unit and integration tests. These verify configuration behavior, check Docker Compose security enforcement policies, and validate SMTP relay configurations to guarantee system resilience.
